chapter.subject: Social Science
source_key_points: 4 CHAPTER Timeline and Sources of History History is “an unending dialogue between the present and the past ...
between the society of today and the society of yesterday.
We can fully understand the present only in the light of the past.” — E.H.
Carr 4 ― Timeline and Sources of History National Museum, New Delhi.
Such museums preserve objects from the past, such as statues, coins and ornaments, all of which help us understand our history.
